write_guard.source_text:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin LC_ALL=C
mode=${1:-plan}
case "$mode" in plan|write) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
CARD=/dev/mmcblk1
IMAGE=/dev/shm/a733-ssh-installer-20261108/a733-ssh-installer.img
IMAGE_DIR=${IMAGE%/*}
expect_output() {
 local expected=$1 actual
 shift
 actual=$("$@") || return 1
 [[ "$actual" = "$expected" ]]
}
expect_output 0 id -u
expect_output 7f1f07c4-5a4f-469f-97a7-612406d915a2 cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
[[ -b "$CARD" && ! -L "$CARD" ]]
expect_output 179:0 cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/dev
expect_output 035344535530324780716f216e00a8f5 cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/device/cid
expect_output SU02G cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/device/name
expect_output 0 cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/ro
expect_output disk lsblk -dn -o TYPE "$CARD"
expect_output 1977614336 blockdev --getsize64 "$CARD"
mounts=$(lsblk -nr -o MOUNTPOINTS "$CARD") || exit 1
[[ ! "$mounts" =~ [^[:space:]] ]]
for node in /sys/class/block/mmcblk1 /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/mmcblk1p*; do
 [[ -d "$node" && -d "$node/holders" ]]
 holders=$(find "$node/holders" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print) || exit 1
 [[ -z "$holders" ]]
done
expect_output 1 wc -l </proc/swaps
expect_output tmpfs findmnt -n -o FSTYPE -T "$IMAGE"
[[ -f "$IMAGE" && ! -L "$IMAGE" && -d "$IMAGE_DIR" && ! -L "$IMAGE_DIR" ]]
expect_output 268435456 stat -c %s "$IMAGE"
expect_output 0:0:600:1 stat -c %u:%g:%a:%h "$IMAGE"
expect_output 0:0:700 stat -c %u:%g:%a "$IMAGE_DIR"
printf '%s  %s\n' d3a02224efdb2c2eeccc7115d84cd6c4b2d75c7d06580b8f7812d12a546bc3f6 "$IMAGE" | sha256sum -c -
printf 'Target: %s SU02G CID 035344535530324780716f216e00a8f5, 1977614336 bytes, unmounted.\n' "$CARD"
printf 'Write plan: first 268435456 bytes only; NVMe and SPI untouched.\n'
if [[ "$mode" = plan ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Known target is already authorized: docs/evidence/storage-write-authorization-20261108.json.
printf 'Writing reviewed PRIVATE SSH RAM installer to the authorized SD target...\n'
dd if="$IMAGE" of="$CARD" bs=4M conv=fsync status=progress
blockdev --flushbufs "$CARD"
printf 'SD write complete. No readback requested; reboot is a separate action.\n'
